newsitem.title: USA: Alumax closes $245 mln sale on some assets.
newsitem.headline: Alumax closes $245 mln sale on some assets.

text.p: Alumax Inc said Wednesday it has completed the sale of certain assets of its fabricated products businesses in Western Europe and the United States for about $245 million.
The company said the buyer was Euramax International Plc, a company formed for the transaction by ACP Holdings.
The businesses sold had total annual sales of about $500 million and about 2,100 employees.
Alumax Inc, an aluminum products company, had year-end 1995 assets of more than $3.1 billion and revenues of more than $2.9 billion.
